display_name: DURA同源契约八阶段完整谱系：35条
description: Continuation owns only this CRIC+DURA matrix; adopts existing healthy F workers without changing scientific code, alternates F/G/G-student jobs, predicts when dependencies ready, then independent scoring. Original360 comparator and other owners preserved. Recovery only adds the immutable G root to Python import search; scientific data, ancestry, recipe and budget unchanged.
authorization: 用户2026-10-21指定CRIC+DURA完整方法，与当前对比配置比较，并详细设计机制时延与消融；五源数量扫点不新跑。

code.commit: Resolved to actual pushed Git release commit
code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python3.10/Torch2.1 FP32 TF32off CPU2

data.physical_ids_ref: Existing source/target data-contract records; no IQ or truth opened for this design/aggregation
data.label_map_ref: Existing native source-contract metadata; no posthoc head fitting
data.validation_ref: Reuse existing VALIDATED_ONCE handles; new contracts bound before actual launch

permissions.regime: G training TX-label-free/F-free; L or L+hidden U as registered
permissions.query_use: Frozen prediction only. All same-row readouts/tasks/views complete before separate CPU truth-last.
permissions.claim_scope: Previously exposed engineering benchmark; not independent blind or in-orbit validation

checkpoint.initialization: Exact-contract scratch ancestry; F0 G mechanisms copy approved R65 unless registered random init arm
sources: Own same-contract immediate parent only; F0 old R65/R69 only for exact F0 roles
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Existing exact-contract F0 evidence; every new F/G/teacher must match its own contract
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: New source contracts cannot inherit old G/F weights; cached simulation IQ may be selected by legal current L/LU IDs
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final stage20/4940; all registered variants test7views regardless source performance

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0..7 one own/card; <=2 total compute apps and free>=12000MiB. Timing exclusive and excludes shared-policyGPU2/3.
execution.stop_rule: Two same-fingerprint technical failures stop new launches; healthy peers retained. No performance-based stopping or target feedback.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent truth-last after all seven predictions per row
